title: Spectral Properties of the Chen-Nagano Gauge on Einstein Manifolds
summary: The stability and deformation theory of Einstein metrics traditionally relies on the classical Berger-Ebin transverse-traceless gauge, which structurally decouples the scalar trace from the divergence-free component of metric perturbations. In the present paper, we introduce a new spectral-geometric framework based on the Chen-Nagano gauge condition. This condition naturally arises from the harmonicity of the identity map and is intrinsically satisfied by the Ricci tensor itself via the contracted second Bianchi identity.
